headline: Microsoft Launches New Surface Mouse With Haptic Feedback
summary: Microsoft is launching a second-generation Surface Mouse with haptic feedback and a customizable action button aimed at Copilot access, according to The Verge and ZDNet. ZDNet says the $80 mouse arrives October 13.

claims.statement: Microsoft is launching a new Surface Mouse with haptic feedback.

sources.quote: Microsoft’s new Surface Mouse has haptic feedback and a customizable action button
Microsoft’s Surface Mouse is back, now with haptic feedback

claims.statement: The mouse has a customizable action button primarily for Copilot access.

launching a second generation of its Surface Mouse next month
